content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to connect to my [product_name] using the new Android app, but it reports that either the username or password is incorrect. In [product_name] configuration software, I've turned off password requirements for app and web access, as well as other online settings. Within the Android app, I haven't provided a username or password. I also can't locate any username setting in the configuration software. I'm using a Samsung Galaxy Note3. Even though I've disabled the web access password on my device, I'm still prompted for a password when connecting from my PC. Is there a way to connect to the device with the new Android app without needing credentials? Best regards, [user_name]
Hello, I've figured out the solution... username = Web User password = [product_name]
I also noticed that even after disabling access control, you are still required to enter a password, which is quite confusing.

analysis.insight_summary: Several users are having trouble connecting to a [product_name] device using the official Android app, mainly due to unclear information around required login credentials. Disabling password protection within the [product_name] configuration software does not remove the prompt for credentials, both in the app and when accessing via PC. There seems to be a lack of transparency regarding default logins and how security settings impact connectivity, resulting in user frustration and reliance on trial and error.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that turning off password or access control on the [product_name] device and its configuration software would make accessing the device easy and not require credentials from either the official Android app or PC web access.
